name: performance-engine-repo
description: Repository scripts for performance-engine (core/), the Perf Intelligence DevTools extension (extension/) and the demo (demo/). Not a workspace: core/ and demo/ install their own dependencies.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix core ci && npm --prefix demo ci
scripts.check: npm run check:core && npm run check:vendor && npm run check:extension && npm run check:demo
scripts.check:core: npm --prefix core run typecheck && npm --prefix core test && npm --prefix core run check:package
scripts.check:demo: npm --prefix demo run lint && npm --prefix demo run build
